download_linter_binary: download a linter binary from S3 using a config JSON with platform-specific URLs and hashes
compute_file_sha256: compute the SHA256 hash of a file and return it as a hexadecimal string
check_binary_hash: check whether a binary exists and matches a reference SHA256 hash, deleting it on mismatch
run_dry_run_init: run the S3 binary initializer in dry-run mode to preview actions without downloading
report_download_progress: report file download progress with a visual progress bar to stdout
